verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is a banking-as-a-service API platform, and a natural-language command interface is a plausible capability for this kind of product. The evidence only shows REST endpoints, HTTP Basic Auth, command-line/Postman testing and webhooks. The llms.txt file is LLM-readable documentation, an adjacent artifact, not a way to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
